grades.quote: When a page-fault, guest-page-fault, or access-fault exception is taken, the relevant *tval CSR is written with the faulting effective address (i.e. the value of _rs1_ ).
grades.reason: Provides CMO fault conditions and a fault-address register, but does not explain how to distinguish a missing mapping from insufficient permissions.
Only index entries; no explanation of mapping validity, access permissions, or fault diagnosis.
